name: genfeed
description: Genfeed playbook skill and hosted MCP server for brands, content, generation, scheduling, and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Genfeed workspace to inspect brands and channels, prepare content, generate media, request scheduled releases, and review analytics. OAuth sign-in is required. Generation can consume Genfeed credits; writes may require a separate Genfeed approval.
defaultPrompt: List my Genfeed brands and check their publishing readiness.
Prepare a LinkedIn draft for my selected brand without publishing it.
Show my content calendar and recent performance.
